summary: Wrote an 8-phase plan for the record-versioning repo-wide lint. Re-derived the research dry-run at authoring time (251 BLOCKING/45 files here, 213/44 in the Verification repo) and measured a candidate two-discriminator narrowing that drops those to 27/19, so three library-fix phases are budgeted ahead of the acceptance check rather than discovering the flood at verification time. Phases 5-7 build the two deliverables and wire them; Phase 8 is the full-gate acceptance phase with residue dispositioned by cause. Every long-command step carries the bounded-wait idiom inline.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan: 4 library-discriminator/corpus phases, 2 deliverable phases, wiring, and a full-gate acceptance phase.
